name: Armaldo
flavor: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

attacks.name: Abyssal Drop
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Choose a spot from among your opponent’s Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent’s next turn, Knock Out the Pokémon in the spot you chose.
